::: {.notes}
About 2 minutes. Keep it to the story: what the programme does and the two
ways businesses got it. Ask: "In which of the two places would it be fairer to
compare businesses that joined with businesses that did not? Why?" Take
answers; do not resolve it yet. The numbers come in the sessions that need them.
:::
